tasks.brief: Implementation constraints: Edit src/services/models.py only. Replace the three hardcoded nemotron URL constants (NEMOTRON_BASE_URL, NEMOTRON_CHAT_ENDPOINT, NEMOTRON_READY_URL) so they derive from os.environ.get("NEMOTRON_URL", "http://localhost:8600"). KEEP the constant NAMES exactly as they are. `os` is already imported. Change nothing else — the shutdown path, signals, and timeouts are untouched this milestone. Do not import anything new. Do not change any function signatures or logic. Behavioral specification: On import, NEMOTRON_BASE_URL reads the env var NEMOTRON_URL (defaulting to http://localhost:8600). NEMOTRON_CHAT_ENDPOINT is NEMOTRON_BASE_URL + "/v1/chat/completions". NEMOTRON_READY_URL is NEMOTRON_BASE_URL + "/v1/models". Acceptance condition: The three constants exist with the exact same names, their values are derived from the env var as specified, and all existing tests in tests/test_models_service.py, tests/test_models_api.py, tests/test_chat_model_routing.py, and tests/test_nemotron_config.py pass without modification.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/app.js only. Two tightly-related edits in the streaming path: (a) Failed-reply history retention (AC-41): in BOTH failure branches — the 'error' event branch inside processFrame, and the fetch .catch at the end of the submit handler — push { role: 'user', content: message } into currentThread.messages (only if not already pushed) and call persistThreads(). Do NOT push an assistant message. Do not alter the 'done' branch. (b) "thinking..." placeholder (AC-42): right after the reply bubble is created, set its text to "thinking...". In the token/think render seam (where replyBubble.innerHTML = renderThink(replyText) runs), when the rendered VISIBLE text is empty (all content is think-spans or nothing), show "thinking..." instead; otherwise show the rendered result. The placeholder must never enter stored history (history is stripThink of replyText, which never contains it) and must not appear once visible answer text streams. Behavioral specification: On failure, the user message is retained in history and persisted. The reply bubble shows "thinking..." initially and when only think content is rendered; it clears to the actual text once visible tokens stream. Acceptance condition: tests/test_ui.py::test_failed_reply_keeps_user_message and tests/test_ui.py::test_thinking_placeholder_shows_then_clears pass, along with all other tests/test_ui.py::* tests.
